note: D-44: the decoder must survive the script the book itself is written in. Real Hebrew, not transliteration, including the right-to-left comma/full-stop placement a naive tokeniser mangles. Same file shape and same OUTPUT vocabulary as hints_en.json - the schema's enum is English regardless of input language, and the matching English cases are `plain-region`, `place-cue`, `heading-only` and `no-locational-content`.

cases.why: The Hebrew counterpart of the English plain-region case.

cases.why: A New York place cue written in Hebrew, with a heading clause after the comma.
